wish: someone should make an app that plays several videos side by side
spec:
Plays up to four of your own video files side by side in a grid, locked to one shared play button, scrubber and speed.
Tap a slot to pick a file (or drop files), nudge each video earlier or later in 0.1 s steps to line them up, choose which ones have sound, go full screen.
Does not upload anything, does not play links from websites, and does not remember files between visits.
notes: CSP media-src extended with blob: so local files picked by the user can play; still zero network.
